title: Unit Event — The Way I Played That Day — Episode1 Where I'm Headed

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day
meta.Event Outline: Kanade continues to write songs in the hope of saving Mafuyu. When her grandmother calls to suggest that she think more about herself and her own future, her thoughts turn toward the past.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you.
I'm always grateful for your hospitality.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
So, how have you been lately?
I hope you're feeling well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
I bought some shortcake from that bakery by the station.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
You like these quite a lot if I recall.
Please have some with Ms. Yoisaki later.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's okay for you to tell me whatever it is that's on your mind, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: But you also don't have to if you don't want to tell me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: However, I'm here because I want to know how you're feeling. I'm here to listen.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't actually like this cake.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for misunderstanding.
Then, can you tell me what you do like?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I haven't been able to taste anything for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Everything I eat... It's all the same to me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: If possible, could you tell me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mafuyu seems more comfortable talking compared to before...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And her dad's making an effort to understand what's going on with her. Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I hope things start moving in a positive direction...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Then, I'll be back again next week.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But I'm a little tired...
I'm going to rest for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, I'll be working in my room.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? A call? Who could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line:
<Kanade?
It's your grandmother. Are you free to talk now?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is there a reason you called?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <I was wondering how you've been doing, Kanade. Is everything okay?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm okay.
Mafuyu... My friend's also doing well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And thanks to Ms. Mochizuki, I've been eating much more regularly. Also, my room's much cleaner now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line:
<Oh, that's wonderful to hear...!
I'll need to thank Honami again the next chance I get.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <By the way, Kanade, I heard that you went to your school's opening ceremony...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line:
<So, how was it?
Were there changes or anything bothering you?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, there's nothing in particular...
I've been keeping up with my studies as usual.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Dad also seems fine.
Not much has changed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <By the way, Kanade, have you been thinking about your future at all?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <I know that's difficult to do considering your father's condition...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <But I believe it's about time for you to start thinking more seriously about your own future.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <Yes. For starters, what are you going to do after you graduate? You need to begin planning for that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <That's why I'd like to hear what you think, Kanade. What would you like to do...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What would I like to do...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <I'm sorry. I know I'm throwing a tough question at you...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <But I hope you'll give it some thought when you get a chance... This is your future we're talking about.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <And I'll support you on whatever endeavors you decide to embark on...>
